targets.title: Catalog hub
targets.summary: Entry point for package ownership, family coverage, example scope, and adoption expectations.
automatedChecks: review routes are generated from stable preview state
manualChecks: landing-page hierarchy and adoption messaging still read clearly
section browser remains usable across themes and densities

targets.title: Form baseline and validation posture
targets.summary: Field wrappers, inputs, search, and action rows with validation and announcement posture.
automatedChecks: stateful route matrix exists for invalid, pending, and sizing review
manualChecks: caret, selection, and IME behavior
screen-reader announcement quality for validation and help text

targets.title: Selection, sorting, and bulk actions
targets.summary: Structured rows with visible-scope selection, sort semantics, row actions, and pagination context.
automatedChecks: sorting and selection review routes are generated
preview URL is stable for repeat review
manualChecks: header affordance clarity and density fit
row action naming and keyboard flow

targets.title: Lists, grids, filters, and search depth
targets.summary: Browse shells that separate ready, loading, empty, and no-results posture across list and grid views.
automatedChecks: contract and package ownership remain linked
manualChecks: empty versus no-results posture clarity
progressive-loading rhythm and content hierarchy

targets.title: Detail display, cards, headers, and navigation
targets.summary: Readonly detail surfaces with breadcrumb context, page headers, cards, and section hierarchy.
automatedChecks: package and contract provenance remain exposed
manualChecks: visual hierarchy, spacing, and summary-card contrast
header action emphasis and reading order

targets.title: Picker, relation, and selection workflows
targets.summary: Searchable attach-or-choose flows with selection summaries, commit/cancel rhythm, and keyboard traversal.
manualChecks: multi-select traversal and confirmation rhythm
announcement quality for search and selection summary updates

targets.title: Preview framing, embeds, and fallback posture
targets.summary: Media surfaces that keep framing, metadata, and fallback meaning explicit without owning playback engines.
manualChecks: thumbnail framing and metadata hierarchy
renderer-failure and fallback posture clarity

targets.title: Banners, toasts, skeletons, and remediation
targets.summary: Persistent and transient state surfaces with loading, remediation, and announcement posture.
manualChecks: toast timing appropriateness and message hierarchy
banner tone fit and remediation action emphasis

targets.title: Palette search, grouped actions, and inline rediscovery
targets.summary: Modal and inline command discovery with grouped results, focus containment, and keyboard movement.
automatedChecks: modal and inline discovery surface stay addressable
manualChecks: focus containment and restoration quality
result ranking readability and command grouping clarity

targets.title: Headers, dock orchestration, and workspace shell posture
targets.summary: App and project headers, docks, tabs, split views, and host-owned layout snapshots.
manualChecks: dock, split, and shell hierarchy legibility
resize affordance feel and focus order through shell regions

targets.title: Runtime-critical values
targets.summary: Live values pulled from the active emitted theme, density, and control-size overlays.
automatedChecks: theme, density, and control-size routes are generated
manualChecks: live readout remains legible in light and dark themes

targets.title: Search the emitted token tree
targets.summary: Searchable inspection of the emitted semantic token paths and their active computed values.
manualChecks: search usability and token-path readability
